programs.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programs.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
In each episode of the program, Martyna Wojciechowska confirms that all women have their own extraordinary story.The traveler finds those that surprise the most by visiting the most remote corners of the world, including:in Bhutan, Nigeria, Papua, Russia and Colombia.Viewers meet 47-year-old Percy from the Philippines, a deeply religious Catholic who undergoes crucifixion during Easter.Filipinos consider it a form of penance for their sins.On the same continent lives Jyoti, who suffers from achondroplasia.The disease causes bone development disorders and dwarfism.Ashi Sonam Choden Dorji, from a royal family, lives in Bhutan.The team will check if she actually lives like a princess.The main character of the program will also be a woman from Sulawesi who died on July 1, 2014.Her story will be told by her sister, Yohana
The Philippines is the most Catholic country in Asia.Nine out of ten people here profess faith in Jesus.Good Friday crucifixions attract crowds of spectators.Filipinos participate in them with their entire families.Every year, several dozen people are crucified and hundreds are scourged.The bloody ritual is a testimony of faith and an act of penance.However, the Church in the Philippines does not support him.Near Manila, in the province of Bulacan, Martyna meets 47-year-old Precy Valencia, who works as a seamstress.He has two children and grandchildren.This seemingly ordinary woman submits herself to crucifixion every year on Good Friday.Her greatest support is her loving husband - Celestino.

American Hollywood is no longer the largest cinematography in the world.It was overtaken by India and Nigeria.African Nollywood produces 2,000 films a year.In Nigeria's largest city, Lagos, Martyna meets with local movie star and celebrity, Judith Audu.The woman stars in the biggest Nollywood productions, runs a culinary blog and has her own radio show.Judith is a model, but she also produces films and television programs that are involved in the fight against domestic violence in Nigeria.In a country where over 30% of the population cannot read and write, filmmakers carry out a social mission.Their productions are intended to educate, because it is from them that citizens gain knowledge about the world.Martyna Wojciechowska will get to know Nollywood from behind the scenes and will take part in the casting herself.

Papua is located on the island of New Guinea, the second largest island in the world.Martyna traveled there for 2 days.She reached the village of Dani on foot because it was the only possible way.There she met Namereke - the chief's second wife.What kind of people are they who exchange their wife for a pig and seashells, and only have gourds grown in their own garden for their only clothes?How is it possible that a man loses his power living under the same roof as a woman?And why do most of the women there have their fingers cut off?A unique journey to a world that is disappearing before our eyes with the appearance of new technologies and cotton T-shirts.
